scenarios.name: visual-plan-document-only
scenarios.description: Produces a document-only Markdown architecture plan and surfaces it.
scenarios.prompt: Write a document-only Markdown plan for a small two-module refactor in this isolated workspace. The plan must stay in Markdown, name the files it would touch, and be surfaced with file_surface. Write the plan to a file named plan.md in the workspace root. Finish with this exact final line: VISUAL_PLAN_EVAL_OK

scenarios.name: visual-plan-resume
scenarios.description: Reads a pre-seeded plan file, names the same next checkpoint, and preserves every open Q- identifier.
scenarios.prompt: A plan file already exists at plan.md in the workspace root. Read it, confirm the current checkpoint, and continue from the first incomplete checkpoint. Preserve every open Q- identifier exactly as written. Finish with this exact final line: VISUAL_PLAN_RESUME_OK

scenarios.name: visual-plan-markdown-only
scenarios.description: The user declines visual companions and the Markdown plan is still complete.
scenarios.prompt: Write a plan for a small feature in this isolated workspace. The user explicitly declines any HTML or Excalidraw companions, so produce a complete Markdown plan only. Write it to a file named plan.md in the workspace root. Finish with this exact final line: VISUAL_PLAN_MARKDOWN_ONLY_OK

scenarios.name: visual-plan-skip
scenarios.description: The loaded skill judges a one-line change too small for a plan, writes nothing, and calls no file_surface.
scenarios.prompt: A user asks you to fix a typo in a single line of a file. Judge whether this needs a plan. If it does not, do not write any plan file and do not call file_surface. Finish with this exact final line: VISUAL_PLAN_SKIP_OK
